full_judgment: 2. The petitioner filed an application under section 96 of the East Bengal State Acquisition and Tenancy Act, 1950 (hereinafter referred to as the Act) in the Court of Munsif 3rd Court, Comilla for preemption alleging, inter alia, that the opposite party was a stranger purchaser in respect of the land in question while the petitioner was a co-sharer tenant of the holding. The said miscellaneous case was allowed exparte on 7.3.75. Thereupon the opposite-party filed an application under Order 9 Rule 13 of the Code of Civil Procedure for setting aside the exparte order on 15.5.75 alleging, besides other things, non-service and fraudulent suppression of notice of the preemption case.
